fact: The Central Bank of Libya says September 2026 public sector salary authorizations from the Ministry of Finance are being transferred to commercial banks for immediate processing via the Your Salary Instantly system, with about 1.75 million of 2.2 million public employees registered (79%).
Central Bank of Libya Governor Naji Issa cited the launch of an "Instant Salary" project among the bank's reform initiatives.
Governor Issa said about 1.75 million of 2.2 million public employees have registered for the Ratibak Lahzi instant-salary project, which cut salary disbursement time to under an hour.
The Central Bank of Libya governor announced on 15 June 2025 a project for full digitisation of government payments, among projects accompanying the National Financial Inclusion Strategy 2025-2029.

Libya's Government of National Unity has begun paying public sector salaries through the new unified treasury account system, with payments to go directly to bank accounts via the Central Bank of Libya's Instant Salary system, the finance minister said.
